preconditions.description: The linked list size N must be between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node.val, int) for node in [head] + [node.next for node in [head] if node.next])
preconditions.description: Each node in the linked list must contain an integer value.
The head node of the linked list must exist.

postconditions.expression: return_value == all(head.val == node.val for node in [head] + [node.next for node in [head] if node.next][::-1])
postconditions.description: The function returns true if the linked list reads the same forwards and backwards (palindrome), false otherwise.
